dependence.conclusion: Residual dependence changes sign and is not stable enough to justify a joint-half correction.

phase29_findings: Bottom-half scoring is systematically underpredicted in pooled 2022-2025 and directionally again in 2026.
I2 expected start slot does not isolate the bias.
Low batter/pitcher training support does not explain the bias.
Bias is associated with scoring-suppressive park effects, but park attenuation fails forward validation/replication.
A precommitted bottom offset + park attenuation challenger improves 2025 but worsens 2026 full-I2 target and is rejected.
Top/bottom residual dependence is unstable and does not justify changing the product construction.
decision: No Phase 29 correction is promoted. Preserve the Phase 28 combined lean research specification unchanged.

next_phase.name: Phase 30 new-signal discovery
next_phase.rule: Stop tuning residual corrections. Test genuinely new pregame information only if it has a defensible causal/forecasting path and can be reconstructed historically without leakage.
priority_candidates: game-day weather/environment beyond static Savant park profile
pregame-available starter workload/freshness and opener/restriction information
as-of-date current-season arsenal evolution versus prior-season-only historical arsenal
next_phase.governance: Each candidate must be added one family at a time, evaluated on exact full-I2 Under 0.5, selected on 2022-2025 or a stricter chronological split where data availability requires it, with 2026 replication only; no market prices.
